description: This file contains the implementation of a data validator class for account transfer details within the Fineract project. It validates JSON input data related to transferring accounts, ensuring required fields are present and meet certain constraints.

classes.name: AccountTransfersDetailDataValidator
classes.description: A component class responsible for validating transfer account details received via JSON commands. It checks for non-null, positive integers and specific value constraints on account IDs, types, and related identifiers.

methods.name: AccountTransfersDetailDataValidator
methods.description: Constructor that injects the JSON helper dependency used for parsing JSON input.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Main validation method that extracts relevant fields from the JSON command and applies validation rules, such as non-null and valid value checks.
